`solve_model` passes the current `n.snapshots` through `_as_model_snapshots`, rather than obtaining snapshots from the built model. That helper only flattens a MultiIndex for a flat model; it cannot restore the model’s representation if the network’s snapshot structure has changed since model creation (for example, from single-period snapshots to a MultiIndex). Thus some call paths can pass snapshots in a different representation from the model’s.
